We can accept 45 days if the late-payment suspension right is removed.
Please confirm the amounts are exclusive of VAT.
Confirmed: all amounts exclude VAT.
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Between Northwind Traders Limited (the "Customer") and Fabrikam Consulting LLP (the "Supplier").
Services
The Supplier shall provide the following services (the "Services"):
design and implementation of the Customer's data platform;
training of up to twenty (20) members of the Customer's staff;
second-line support during business hours.
The Supplier shall perform the Services
with reasonable skill and care
and in accordance with good industry practice.
Fees and payment
The Customer shall pay the fees set out in the table below. Invoices are payable within
forty-five (45) days
thirty (30) days
of receipt.
